run_avg_rank_cli: run the avg_rank script to compute average rank for a negotiation model using argparse CLI
read_dataset_function: read a negotiation dataset file and extract unique sentences with context and dialogue turns
rollout_scoring: compute a rollout score by simulating 5 conversation rollouts and aggregating agreement probability with domain scores
likelihood_scoring: compute the likelihood score of a given sentence using the model's score_sent method
compute_rank_function: compute the rank of a target sentence by scoring all sentences and finding its position in the sorted list
